_read_me: Starter values for construction trades. Which equipment each trade must wear is for your safety officer to confirm against the rules that apply to your site. Edit this file; nothing is hard-coded. Allowed items: helmet, vest, goggles, gloves, boots. 'also_needs' is text for equipment SiteGuard cannot check yet.

welder.label: Welder
also_needs: welding shield, fire-resistant clothing (cannot be checked yet)

grinder.label: Grinding / cutting
also_needs: ear protection, dust mask (cannot be checked yet)

site_supervisor.label: Site supervisor (held to the same rules)

references_to_check: Building and Other Construction Workers (Regulation of Employment and Conditions of Service) Act, 1996 and the Central Rules, 1998
Occupational Safety, Health and Working Conditions Code, 2020 (check its current commencement status)

BIS standards for protective equipment, for example IS 2925 (industrial safety helmets) and the IS 15298 series (personal protective equipment): confirm the exact numbers and editions with your safety officer
